entities.name: PMID:27501431
observations: Stevens and O’Connell (2016), Rapid Communications in Mass Spectrometry 30:1969–1984; directly compared red deer bone and antler collagen δ13C and δ15N.

entities.name: Red deer tissue isotope offsets
observations: In six Isle of Rum stags, bone δ13C and δ15N were higher than antler values in most comparisons; collagen values varied within and among antlers. Authors conclude the tissues are not isotopically equivalent or directly comparable.
